task_description: Create a simple unique profile/settings screen for the SSS Flutter app

patterns.screen_pattern: StatefulWidget with late AppSettings _settings initialized from PreferencesService.settings in initState
patterns.model_pattern: copyWith with nullable params using ?? fallback, auto-sets updatedAt
patterns.theme_pattern: Use Theme.of(context).colorScheme for colors, AppThemeExtension.of(context) for gradients
patterns.section_header_pattern: Padding fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 8) with titleSmall style in primary color

existing_implementations.description: Existing settings_screen.dart handles image recognition settings. AppSettings model has 4 fields. PreferencesService initialized in StorageService.initialize(). 8 theme variants available via AppThemeMode enum.

constraints.no_backend: Local-only profile, no cloud sync or authentication
constraints.theme_consistency: Use existing theme tokens, no hardcoded colors
constraints.simple_design: Keep UI simple while adding unique visual elements
